2610.13732.title: LAPT-Scale: Scaling Embodied Policies with Latent Action Pre-Training on Human Videos
2610.13732.paper_summary: Scaling generalist robotic policies is limited by the high cost of collecting embodied interaction data. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer a rich alternative, but they lack robot action labels, and existing action annotation methods are often noisy under real-world visual complexity and diverse manipulation dynamics. We introduce LAPT-Scale, a scalable latent action pre-training paradigm with two components: LAPT-Scale-LAM learns continuous latent actions by explaining frame-to-frame visual transitions in human videos and uses them as human-derived supervision, while LAPT-Scale-Policy trains a VLA policy through human-video latent-action pre-training, target-robot embodiment alignment, and task-specific post-training. Unlike prior vector-quantized LAMs, LAPT-Scale-LAM uses a continuous latent space to preserve fine-grained motion and interaction dynamics. We further combine perceptual, semantic, and optical-flow alignment signals to improve transition-level supervision beyond pixel reconstruction. Trained on 23.3K hours of egocentric video, LAPT-Scale-LAM provides implicit action supervision for policy pre-training, yielding consistent scaling gains and improving real-robot success from 63.3% to 85.0% as annotated human video scales from 1K to 5K hours. The learned policy also generalizes to unseen visual conditions.
2610.13732.paper_summary_zh: 擴展通用機器人政策受到收集具體互動數據的高成本限制。大規模的自我中心人類視頻提供了一個豐富的替代方案，但它們缺乏機器人行動標籤，現有的行動註釋方法在現實世界的視覺複雜性和多樣的操作動態下往往會產生噪音。我們介紹了 LAPT-Scale，一種可擴展的潛在行動預訓練範式，包含兩個組件：LAPT-Scale-LAM 通過解釋人類視頻中幀與幀之間的視覺轉換來學習連續的潛在行動，並將其用作人類衍生的監督，而 LAPT-Scale-Policy 通過人類視頻潛在行動預訓練、目標機器人具現對齊和任務特定的後訓練來訓練 VLA 政策。與先前的向量量化 LAM 不同，LAPT-Scale-LAM 使用連續潛在空間來保留細緻的運動和互動動態。我們進一步結合感知、語義和光流對齊信號，以改善超越像素重建的過渡級別監督。在 23.3K 小時的自我中心視頻上訓練的 LAPT-Scale-LAM 為政策預訓練提供了隱式行動監督，產生了一致的擴展增益，並將真實機器人的成功率從 63.3% 提高到 85.0%，隨著註釋的人類視頻從 1K 擴展到 5K 小時。學到的政策也能夠對未見過的視覺條件進行泛化。
